info.title: Customer 360 Intelligence Platform
info.description:
Customer 360 Intelligence Platform API.

Deterministic customer data, agent-generated insights and grounded natural-language Q&A over a
read-only banking dataset. Monetary values are integer cents internally and decimal strings at this
boundary; every response carries a correlation ID and trace ID in `meta`.

get.description: Return 200 while the process is alive. Touches no dependency.
Report readiness of every registered subsystem, failing closed on any blocking check.

503.description: One or more components are not ready

post.summary: Password grant: exchange seeded credentials for a token pair
post.description: Authenticate a seeded user and issue an access/refresh token pair.

post.summary: Refresh grant: exchange a refresh token for a fresh token pair
post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a fresh access/refresh pair.

post.summary: Rebuild derived values, the search index and the graph projection
post.description: Rebuild all derived state (design §14.6). Idempotent and non-destructive to source data.

500.description: A projection failed a referential-integrity check

503.description: The customer database is not available

post.summary: Detect proactive signals and rebuild the worklist store (Phase 17)
post.description:
Run signal detection over the read-only customer database (task 17.4).

Admin-only by design, following the same authorization story as ``/admin/recompute``: role-based
admin guarding is added when the platform gains an admin role; until then the endpoint is
non-destructive to source data — it only reads the read-only customer database and writes the
separate, reconstructible ``signals.db``. Idempotent via ``dedup_key``, so it is safe to
schedule and safe to re-run.

503.description: The customer database is not available

post.summary: Run every due report schedule and deliver via the configured deliverer (Phase 18)
post.description:
Run all due report schedules (task 18.4).

Admin-only by design, following the same authorization story as ``/admin/recompute`` and
``/admin/detect-signals``. Each due schedule's owner is re-resolved to their *live* principal at
generation time (never the stored snapshot), so a revoked book stops receiving data. Non-
destructive to source data: it only reads the read-only customer database and writes the
separate ``reports.db`` and the artifact volume.

503.description: The customer or report database is not available

get.description:
FTS search over the customer index, scoped to the principal's book (requirements 3.1,
3.3).

get.summary: All holdings (optionally filtered by account type)
Credit profile (FICO, behaviour, utilization), masked per role
Risk profile, band, exposure and alerts
Ranked offers with suppression reasons and campaigns
Engagement history, newest first, filterable by channel and event type
get.description:
Engagement events across channels (requirement 7.6).

The optional ``channel`` and ``event_type`` filters are comma-separated lists; an unknown value
is a client error (422) rather than a silently-ignored filter, matching the ``type`` filter on
holdings.

The composed 360 view. A module that fails is isolated into ``meta.errors[]`` and its slot is
omitted, so the response is a partial 200 rather than a whole-dashboard failure (requirement
4.4).

Retrieve passages for ``q``, entitlement-filtered, and audit the documents returned.

Reranking is not enabled on this endpoint: it is the search surface, held to the dashboard-agent
budget. The Q&A path (Phase 9) enables reranking on its own route.

Return document metadata, or 404 if unknown or above the role's entitlement (17.8).

Absent and forbidden are collapsed into 404, so the endpoint is not an existence oracle for
restricted documents — the same discipline the customer endpoints apply.

Document metadata is institutional reference data (task 16.2): it changes only on re-ingestion,
not per request or per role. The response therefore carries a strong ``ETag`` and a short
``Cache-Control`` so a repeat read can be a conditional ``304`` rather than a full round trip.

get.summary: Stream the AI insight cards as server-sent events
get.description: Stream every insight card (all agents except the offer recommendation) over SSE.

get.summary: Stream the AI recommendation card as server-sent events
get.description: Stream the next-best-offer recommendation card over SSE.

post.summary: Ask a grounded natural-language question about a customer (SSE)
post.description: Authorize, audit, run the Q&A graph, and stream the grounded answer (task 9.5).

post.summary: Ask a grounded natural-language question across all entitled customers (SSE)
post.description:
Answer a cross-customer question and stream the grounded answer (task 9.6).

The search-landing "Ask anything" entry point. There is no customer to authorize up front, so
the agent resolves one with the entitlement-scoped ``customer_search`` tool and every reading
tool re-authorizes the id it resolves to — entitlement is enforced per result, not skipped. The
access is audited fail-closed before answering, and a refusal (a tool that reached a
non-entitled customer) is audited as a denied access, disclosing nothing.

get.summary: The caller's ranked, entitlement-scoped signals worklist
get.description:
The prioritized daily worklist across the caller's entitled book (task 17.3, 17.5).

Ranked by severity x value-at-stake x recency, suppressing dismissed and cooled-off signals.
Returns an empty page when signal detection has not run yet.

Every signal for one customer, behind the same 403-vs-404 gate as the 360 view (task
17.5).

post.summary: Dismiss a signal for the calling user
post.description: Suppress a signal from the caller's queue for the cooling-off window (task 17.5).

404.description: No such signal, or not entitled to its customer

post.summary: Acknowledge (mark actioned) a signal for the calling user
post.description:
Mark a signal actioned for the caller, permanently suppressing it from their queue (task
17.5).

404.description: No such signal, or not entitled to its customer

post.description: Create a report definition owned by the caller (task 18.5).
Generate the report now, entitlement re-checked and masked (task 18.2, 18.5).

404.description: No such report, or not owned by the caller

get.description: Every run of a definition the caller owns, newest first (task 18.5).

404.description: No such report, or not owned by the caller

get.description: Stream the generated artifact for a run the caller owns (task 18.5).

404.description: No such run, not owned by the caller, or no artifact

post.summary: Attach a schedule to a report
post.description: Attach a cron-like cadence to a report the caller owns (task 18.4, 18.5).

404.description: No such report, or not owned by the caller

delete.description: Deactivate a schedule so it stops running (task 18.5).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Conversation session; memory is keyed by (session_id, customer_id).

AskRequest.title: AskRequest
AskRequest.description: The Q&A request body: a question and the session it belongs to (design §10.2).

BrandingBody.title: BrandingBody
BrandingBody.description: Per-definition branding (task 18.1). Falls back to platform defaults when omitted.

CheckStatus.title: CheckStatus
CheckStatus.description: Outcome of a single readiness check.

CustomerSearchHit.title: CustomerSearchHit
CustomerSearchHit.description:
One row of an FTS5 ``customer_search`` result (requirement 3.1).

Deliberately thin — id, name, segment and the city the match came from — because a search result
list is a picker, not a profile. The identifying columns the index searches on (email, phone,
account and loan numbers, card last-4) are *not* echoed back: a hit on a card's last four digits
should return the customer, not re-display the digits that were typed, and returning them would
put maskable values on a path the field-masking serializer does not cover. Selecting the profile
then goes through :meth:`CustomerService.get_profile`, which is masked.

DismissResult.title: DismissResult
DismissResult.description: The outcome of a dismiss/ack write.

EntitlementSummary.title: EntitlementSummary
EntitlementSummary.description:
A non-identifying description of the caller's entitlement scope.

``kind`` is ``ALL`` / ``BOOK`` / ``SEGMENT``; ``count`` is the size of a book or the number of
segments (``None`` for ``ALL``). The book's customer ids themselves are not returned — the
client
does not need them and echoing a whole book back on every load would be needless exposure.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: The complete error code set from design §6.3.

KnowledgeDomain.title: KnowledgeDomain
KnowledgeDomain.description: The six knowledge domains (design §9.2). Mirrors the ``kb_document.domain`` CHECK set.

KnowledgePassage.title: KnowledgePassage
KnowledgePassage.description: One cited passage from the tool: text plus everything needed to cite it (17.5, 17.6).

KnowledgeSearchPayload.title: KnowledgeSearchPayload
KnowledgeSearchPayload.description: ``GET /knowledge/search`` payload: cited passages and retrieval counters (17.5, 17.6).

ModuleError.title: ModuleError
ModuleError.description: A single domain module's failure, surfaced without failing the whole response.

ReadyPayload.title: ReadyPayload
ReadyPayload.description: Readiness payload: the aggregate plus every component's outcome.

row_counts.title: Row Counts
row_counts.description: Rows written per projected target (derived tables, search index, graph).

RecomputePayload.title: RecomputePayload
RecomputePayload.description: What the recompute produced: per-target row counts and how long it took.

ReportScopeKind.title: ReportScopeKind
ReportScopeKind.description:
What a report runs over (task 18.1).

* ``CUSTOMER`` — a single customer, named by ``customer_id``.
* ``BOOK`` — an explicit set of customer ids the owner is entitled to.
* ``SEGMENT`` — every customer in one or more segments, within the owner's entitlement.

ReportType.title: ReportType
ReportType.description:
The closed set of report kinds Phase 18 produces.

* ``PDF_PACK`` — a branded 360 PDF pack per customer, assembled from the masked service reads
  (task 18.2).
* ``MEETING_BRIEFING`` — a prepare-for-meeting briefing composing the 360 summary, open signals
  and cited talking points (task 18.3).

RunView.title: RunView
RunView.description: A run's status and provenance, value-free (task 18.5).

ScopeBody.title: ScopeBody
ScopeBody.description: The scope a report runs over (task 18.1).

TokenPayload.title: TokenPayload
TokenPayload.description: An issued token pair, in the OAuth 2.0 response shape.
